a.address_statement: The museum is at Aros Allé 2, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark (search result text for the aros.dk pages; the VisitDenmark listing gives the same street address: "Aros Allé 2, 8000, Aarhus, Denmark").

a.address: 1 Kitchener Street, Auckland 1010, New Zealand (corner of Wellesley Street East and Kitchener Street)
a.address_statement: The Gallery is at the corner of Wellesley Street East and Kitchener Street in central Auckland, postcode 1010. Enter through the main doors at 1 Kitchener Street.
a.notes: Built from two phrases on the official visitor information result (street entrance "1 Kitchener Street" and "postcode 1010"), not one single address line. The postal address is a PO Box (PO Box 5449, Victoria Street West, Auckland 1142), which is a mailing address and not the venue. An Auckland Council listing gave "Corner Kitchener and Wellesley streets" without a number, consistent with the official page. An AI-generated travel page said "Wellesley Street East" and was ignored.

a.address_statement: MACBA's main address is Plaça dels Àngels, 1, 08001 Barcelona.
a.notes: Stated in both searches (the first quoted the official contact page; the second restricted to macba.cat returned the same). The Research and Documentation Centre and the library are a separate part of the institution at Plaça dels Àngels, 8, 08001 Barcelona. The MACBA Store is at Plaça dels Àngels 1.

a.address_statement: The main address for Kunsthalle Basel is Steinenberg 7, 4051 Basel, Switzerland.
a.notes: From the search restricted to kunsthallebasel.ch; the summary does not name which of the official pages carries the line, so the Visit and Imprint pages are both given. The postcode conflicts between sources: the official site and most listings use 4051, while the official tourism site (basel.com) was reported to use 4001. The library and archive are reached via a different entrance at Klostergasse 5, 4051 Basel, which is not the main public venue. The main entrance at Steinenberg 7 needs staff assistance, per the same result.

a.address_statement: The Kunstmuseum Basel's main building is at St. Alban-Graben 16, 4051 Basel.
a.notes: The museum has three venues: Hauptbau (St. Alban-Graben 16), Neubau (St. Alban-Graben 20) and Gegenwart (St. Alban-Rheinweg 60, 4052 Basel). The Hauptbau is taken as the main public venue. The street and number 16 come from the museum's own 'Our three venues' page. The 4051 postcode comes from the MySwitzerland listing, which is a tourism board page and not the museum's own site. The museum's own contact page gives a different mailing address, 'St. Alban-Graben 8, CH-4010 Basel', and the site notice gives 'Alban-Graben 16 Postfach 4010 Basel', so 4010 is the postal and PO-box code. That 4010 code conflicts with the 4051 above. Check the postcode against the museum's own page before publishing.

a.address_statement: Dia Beacon is at 3 Beekman Street, Beacon, New York 12508, with a phone line of 845 231 0811.

a.address_statement: The Gropius Bau's address is Niederkirchnerstraße 7, 10963 Berlin, as listed on the Berliner Festspiele information page.

a.address_statement: Mercer Union is at 1286 Bloor Street West, Toronto, ON M6H 1N9, one block east of Lansdowne.
a.notes: From the institution's own Visit page (result titled '1286 Bloor Street West'). The gallery is described as street level, just east of Lansdowne subway station. No conflicting address found.

a.address_statement: Western Front is at 303 E 8th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5T 1S1, at the corner of E 8th Ave and Scotia St in the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood.
a.notes: A second search attributes the address '303 E 8th Ave, Vancouver, BC, CA, V5T 1S1' explicitly to the ArtsBC listing. The first search gave the same address and also pointed to a westernfront.ca visitor guide PDF, described as older and COVID-era, so it is not confirmed that the PDF is the source of that line. No westernfront.ca contact page was returned, so the address is not confirmed from the institution's main site pages. No conflicting address found.

a.address: Edifício Copan, loja 54, Avenida Ipiranga, 200, 01046-925 São Paulo, Brasil
a.address_statement: Pivô SP Edifício Copan, loja 54 Avenida Ipiranga, 200 01046-925 São Paulo, Brasil is the address listed on the official site.
a.notes: Found on the institution's own site (pivo.org.br, about page). The result also says Pivô SP is in the Edifício Copan in downtown São Paulo. Single venue stated.

Two searches returned no street address for L'Appartement 22 in Rabat. The Contemporary And listing confirms the space (founded October 2002 by Abdellah Karroum, website www.appartement22.com) but gives no address. One directory page (telecontact.ma) showed '3 rue Oued Sebou, appt. 22 Rabat Maroc' among many unrelated Rabat businesses without naming the institution, so it was not used. Results about 'Le 22 Appart' Hôtel' in Casablanca are a different business.

Sources conflict on the street name and none is the official site. One listing (artfactories.net) gives '10 Minnaar Street • Fordsburg • Johannesburg', with a postal box in Newtown (PO Box 794, 2113). Another listing gives '10 Mahlathini St, Fordsburg, Johannesburg, South Africa'. Neither includes a postcode, and the official bagfactoryart.org.za contact page did not appear in two searches (only older notices and residency pages). The artfactories.net page also carries an old email domain, so it may be outdated. Left empty because the street name could not be settled from a named source.

a.address_statement: Spike Island's address is 133 Cumberland Road, Bristol, BS1 6UX.
a.notes: Taken from the Charity Commission register entry for Spike Island Artspace Limited (charity 1003505) and the Visit Bristol listing, which give the same address. The institution's own site (spikeisland.org.uk) did not appear in either search's results. Other tenants such as Spike Print Studio share the site; this record is for the Spike Island artspace.

Left empty because the sources conflict and hangar.org's own contact page did not appear in either search. The residency directory (artres.moc.gov.tw) and Sculpture Network give Passatge Marqués de Santa Isabel, 40, 08018 Barcelona. The Barcelona City Council listing, OpenStreetMap and a 2015 event listing give Carrer Emília Coranty, 16 (Council: 'C Emília Coranty, 8*16'). Both are described as lying in the Can Ricart complex, Poblenou. The OpenStreetMap record was last checked January 2021. Check hangar.org directly.

a.address_statement: The CA2M is at Avenida Constitución, 23, 28931 Móstoles, Madrid, in the Madrid Region.
a.notes: The venue is in Móstoles, in the Madrid Region, not in Madrid city, although the record gives the city as Madrid. The address comes from the Spain.info listing (the Spain tourism board). The second search repeated it as 'Avenida Constitución 23, 28931 Móstoles, Madrid' and 'Av. de la Constitucion, 23., 28931 Móstoles, Spain'. ca2m.org's own practical-information page could not be opened, so it is not confirmed there.

Left empty because two Warsaw institutions use the Foksal name and the results do not settle which one this record is. The record's website, galeriafoksal.pl, is the historic Galeria Foksal. For it, a culture.pl listing gives ul. Foksal 1/4, 00-950 Warsaw, but the search text says that listing may be dated and could not be confirmed on the gallery's own site. The Foksal Gallery Foundation (Fundacja Galerii Foksal, fgf.com.pl) is a separate institution. It is listed at ul. Górskiego 1A, 00-033 Warsaw (culture.pl, Warsaw Gallery Weekend), and the results say the two operate independently. The results also disagree about the Foundation's earlier street (Górczewska). Check galeriafoksal.pl's contact page.

a.address_statement: A Warsaw city museum guide places the museum at ul. Marszałkowska 103, 00-110 Warsaw.
a.notes: The address comes from the Warsaw city museum guide (muzea.waw.pl), whose entry also gives the current visitor details: Tue–Sun 12:00–20:00, closed Monday. A directory listing in the second search also gives 'Marszałkowska 103, Warszawa mazowieckie 00-110, Polska', with website artmuseum.pl, but the search text does not say which of its links carries that line, so only muzea.waw.pl is cited. The museum's own site, artmuseum.pl, was not reached. A conflicting address, Pańska 3, 01-124 Warszawa (museum.de, a jobs site), is described as a temporary office from before the move, not the public venue. The results report the new building on Plac Defilad opened in October 2024. Aleje Jerozolimskie 3 belongs to the National Museum in Warsaw, a different institution.

Left empty. Neither search returned a public venue address from tranzit.cz's own site. The 2026 Biennale Matter of Art is spread over three venues (National Gallery Prague - Trade Fair Palace, GAMPA Pardubice, Tusculum Prague), and the record name combines tranzit.cz with the biennale, so no single main public venue is clear. The only street address found was the registered seat of the association tranzit.cz (Dittrichova 349/13, Nové Město, 120 00 Praha 2), from the commercial-register aggregator https://rejstrik-firem.kurzy.cz/26601443/. That is a company-register seat, not shown to be a public venue, and it is not an official source, so it is not used. Reviewer may want to check cz.tranzit.org directly.

a.address_statement: MeetFactory is at Ke Sklárně 3213/15, 150 00 Praha 5 (Smíchov). The official site lists opening hours of 13:00 to 20:00, plus evening programs, and GPS coordinates of 50.053653, 14.408441 MeetFactory, o. p. s. Ke Sklárně 3213/15 150 00 Praha 5.
a.notes: Two searches gave the same address. The search summary attributes the address line to the official site (meetfactory.cz) and it was also consistent across the official tourist-board pages (visitczechia.com, kudyznudy.cz) listed in the Links. The individual pages were not fetched, so which exact page carries the address line is not pinned down. Phone and email differ between listings but are not part of this field.

a.address_statement: Trafó House of Contemporary Arts is at Liliom utca 41, 1094 Budapest. Several listings agree on this address, including the EDN network profile, which also gives the general contact email as info@trafo.hu and the website as www.trafo.hu.
a.notes: Both searches returned the same address from several listings (EDN member profile, My Art Guides, ArtRabbit, Dunapart venues pages). No page on trafo.hu itself in the results was shown to state the address, so the sources are a dance-network member profile and an art-guide listing, not the institution's own site. The result also notes the building is a former electrical transformer station in the 9th district, consistent with the 1094 postcode. Trafó's director is stepping down at the end of 2026; this does not affect the address.

a.address_statement: The Kassák Museum is at Fő tér 1, 1033 Budapest, in the Zichy palace. The official website lists the phone number as +36 1 368 70 21 and the email as kassakmuseum@pim.hu.
a.notes: The second search states the official site lists the address as Fő tér 1, H-1033 Budapest (written with the H- country prefix there; the first search writes it as 1033 Budapest). The museum is in the Zichy palace (Zichy kastély). The official site carries a notice that opening hours are temporarily changed; directories disagree on Thursday hours. No sign of closure or move.

Closed or relocating, so left empty. Het HEM's own announcement (https://hethem.nl/EN/Blog/2024-06-17/Het-HEM-Is-Closing-Its-Doors-On-The-Hembrugterrein-In-Zaandam) says it would close its Zaandam building at the end of summer 2024, with all activities stopping by 1 August, and that it is looking into relocation options in Amsterdam. The hethem.nl contact page (https://hethem.nl/en/Het-Hem/Contact) still shows Warmperserij 1, 1505 RL Zaandam but also refers to the closing and to renovations, so that address is not treated as a current public venue. No new venue address found in the results. The HEMbrug Museum (Kanonnenloods 14, Zaandam) is a different organisation.

a.address_statement: Marres is a house for contemporary culture at Capucijnenstraat 98, 6211 RT Maastricht. (current marres.org site: "Marres, House for Contemporary Culture Capucijnenstraat 98 6211 RT Maastricht +31 (0) 43 327 02 07 info@marres.org")
a.notes: Official site and the museum.nl listing agree on the address. Older marres.org pages (older.marres.org, old.marres.org) have different opening hours but were not used for the address.

a.address_statement: The most recent listing gives Fortstraat 5A in Saint-Gilles (B-1060), open Monday to Friday, 10:00–17:00, and recommends calling ahead.
a.notes: Lower confidence. The search result describes constantvzw.org/site/Contacts.html as the current contact page, but the result set contains several versions of that page that disagree. Older pages give Fortstraat 5 (without the A), and the search text itself gives only a paraphrase of the page, so the exact wording on the page was not seen. Constant also lists a separate studio at Jetsesteenweg 388 Chaussee de Jette, B-1081 Koekelberg, where visitors must email first. The office was taken as the main public venue because it has weekday opening hours and visitors are welcomed. The constantvzw.org page about the office only says Saint-Gilles near the Parvis de Saint-Gilles, with no street. Verify against the live contact page.

a.address_statement: The official contact page lists the main address as 41, rue Notre-Dame, L-2240 Luxembourg, with a second entrance on boulevard Roosevelt.
a.notes: From the institution's own Contact / Access page. There is a second entrance on boulevard Roosevelt, which is the lift-accessible one.

a.address_statement: Beursschouwburg is at Auguste Ortsstraat 20-28, 1000 Brussels.
a.notes: Both searches gave the same address. The second search wrote it as 'Auguste Ortsstraat 20-28 1000 Brussel' and called it the main contact details, next to the press address press@beursschouwburg.be. The result text does not say which link carries the line, so the two URLs are the Links entries most likely to hold it (the venue's own press newsroom and a venue listing), not a confirmed match. The institution's own site beursschouwburg.be did not appear in the Links. A VRT article (June 2025) in the results reports planned major renovation work, with the venue expected to leave the Auguste Ortsstraat building. The search text gives no firm date, so the address is given as the current venue.

a.address_statement: The address is Fortwachter 1, 2141 EE Vijfhuizen.
a.notes: The same address came back in both searches. The first search says museum.nl lists the same address, and the second attributes it to Artrabbit's listing. Both sources are third-party listings. The institution's own site (kunstfort.nl) did not appear in the Links, so the address was not checked against it.

Left empty because the evidence is too weak. The first search gave one unattributed line, 'One listing gives it as Houtkaai 15, Aalst, Belgium', with no postcode. The Links mixed a venue database page (ibsenstage.hf.uio.no) with Expedia travel pages, and the text does not say which one carries the line. That listing gave the website as http://www.netwerk-art.be/, not the netwerkaalst.be on record. The second search (query including netwerkaalst.be) found no official page and returned only unrelated 'Netwerk' results. Houtkaai 15 is an unconfirmed lead, not a verified address.

a.address_statement: The venue is at Mariannenplatz 2, 10997 Berlin, an exhibition space for contemporary art with a focus on current social and cultural issues.
a.notes: Both searches gave this address, and the first says several listings give it. The result text does not say which link carries the line, so the two URLs are the listings most likely to hold it. The official site kunstraumkreuzberg.de appeared in the first search only as an accessibility page (https://kunstraumkreuzberg.de/zugaenglichkeit/), and the result text does not show the address from it. One berlin.de ticket listing, per the first search, writes the address as 'Mariannenplatz 2 B', so there is a minor variant in the sources. The venue is inside the Bethanien building in Berlin Kreuzberg.
